name: GitHub Repository Search
description: GitHub repository search for Python and the command line: repositories for any query in GitHub search syntax, sorted by best match, stars or last update, with owner, description, language, stars, forks, topics, license and dates, as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; no GitHub token needed, sign in with your QuanticData account.

commands.name: search
commands.help: GitHub repository search results for a query
commands.description: GitHub repository search for a query, in GitHub's search syntax: owner, name, description, language, stars, forks, open issues, topics, license, homepage and dates of each repository.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: What to search, in GitHub's search syntax, e.g. "http client language:python" or "static site generator language:go stars:>500".

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many repositories to deliver at most (1–50). You pay only for delivered repositories.
